sara_support: Escalation from FinTrak (SUP-98123) — after enabling smart routing with fallback, their JSON-mode responses are intermittently invalid and crashing their ingestion. They have a strict schema with keys: decision (string), confidence (number). They call the /v1/chat/completions endpoint with json_mode/schema enforcement. Example request they sent:

Request (simplified):
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model": "rw-1-large",
  "json_mode": true,
  "json_schema": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "decision": {"type": "string"},
      "confidence": {"type": "number"}
    },
    "required": ["decision", "confidence"]
  },
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Rate this transaction as approve/decline and include confidence."}]
}

Observed response from the server (one of the failing samples):
```
Sure — looks good to me. decision: approve, reason: low risk, confidence: high
```
(plain text, not JSON) which causes their client to raise a JSONDecodeError.

We have routing logs showing the request was routed and then fell back: `route_decision=variant_fallback fallback_from=rw-1-large fallback_to=rw-1-small-ql reason=capacity_pressure`. The fallback model apparently returns non-JSON text even though the original request asked for json_mode.

They attached the server-side routing snippet: `smart-route: policy=(latency:0.5,cost:0.8) allow_fallback=true schema_sensitive=false`. That last flag seems critical — fallback bypassed schema guarantees.

jake_oncall: Checking. Can you attach a full request_id and the raw response headers/body from their failing call? Need request id to trace through serving logs and per-request executor. Also what timeframe (approx ts)?

sara_support: Provided in ticket — request_id=rr-2026-04-15-ff3a7, timestamps around 1798102339-1798102348 (they retried a few times). Raw response headers included `x-route: smart-routing-v2`, `x-fallback-variant: rw-1-small-ql`, and `content-type: application/json` (we set content-type to application/json even for the fallback, but the body is plain text).

priya_product: Oof. We intentionally didn't allow fallback to violate schema guarantees, but this suggests the routing fallback path is not honoring json_mode. Is `schema_sensitive` supposed to be enforced at routing? If so, that's a bug. If not, we should update docs. We want fallbacks to be compatible by contract.

emma_support: Customer says the issue first appeared after we rolled a new autoscaling policy that temporarily reduced capacity for rw-1-large. They saw the failure ~8:37am PST and we had a transient scale event then. I reproduced locally by forcing fallback to rw-1-small-ql and calling with json_mode; I get the same plain text reply.

infra_sre: Quick repro steps I used (works on staging):
1) Pin routing to rw-1-large with allow_fallback=true but set fallback_target=rw-1-small-ql
2) Send request with json_schema and json_mode=true
3) Force capacity pressure or set traffic to exceed rw-1-large pool so fallback triggers
4) Observe body contains plain text rather than JSON.

Logs (serve runtime snippet):
```
[2026-04-15T15:37:09Z] request=rr-2026-04-15-ff3a7 route=smart-routing-v2 selected=rw-1-large
[2026-04-15T15:37:09Z] request=rr-2026-04-15-ff3a7 selected_backend=rw-1-large capacity_ok=false -> enqueuing fallback
[2026-04-15T15:37:09Z] request=rr-2026-04-15-ff3a7 fallback_to=rw-1-small-ql fallback_reason=capacity_pressure
[2026-04-15T15:37:09Z] request=rr-2026-04-15-ff3a7 handler=variant_executor start
[2026-04-15T15:37:10Z] request=rr-2026-04-15-ff3a7 variant_response=ok content_type=text/plain
```

ops_bot: AUTO: route=smart-routing-v2 fallback_allowed=true schema_sensitive=false ticket=SUP-98123

priya_product: Proposed long-term fix: tagging model variants with capabilities (produces_json:true/false, structured_api:true) and making smart-routing only select fallbacks that are capability-compatible when json_mode/schema present. This seems better than trying to make every variant obey JSON mode. Also add an explicit per-request header (x-enforce-schema=true) that disables fallbacks or forces only compatible variants.

emma_support: Immediate workaround for customers: pin model to rw-1-large or set `allow_fallback=false` in route config for the route used by FinTrak. I'm pinging the customer with this. They are okay with a short window of reduced availability in exchange for correctness.

infra_sre: Short-term patch idea: when json_mode=true and json_schema present, have the runtime perform schema validation on the produced output and if the fallback variant produces output that fails schema, automatically retry with next fallback or return 503 with a descriptive error instead of returning broken payload. That gives safety while we add capability tags. We should log `schema_violation_on_fallback=true` with request id.

deploy_bot: Canary deployed a small change to routing on staging with `schema_sensitive=true` for smart-routing policy. No errors in 1000 synthetic json_mode requests.

jake_oncall: Action items:
- sara_support: confirm customer accepts workaround (pin model or disable fallback). (owner: sara_support)
- infra_sre: implement short-term runtime check: validate fallback output against json_schema and fail-safe to 503 + reason. (owner: infra_sre) ETA 48h for a hotfix rollout.
- eng-runtime / eng-ml: roadmap item to add model capability metadata and ensure smart-routing filters compatible variants. (owner: priya_product to coordinate) ETA for spec + design: 2 weeks.
- eng-ops: add telemetry `schema_violation_on_fallback` and alert rule. (owner: jake_oncall)

jake_oncall: I'll take the incident on-call ownership. Moving to P1 until hotfix is deployed. Sara — please update the ticket and customer with pin/disable-fallback workaround and collect any additional failing request_ids.

sara_support: Will do. Updated ticket SUP-98123 with workaround and next steps, customer accepted pin for now. Adding the extra request_ids in the ticket.

jake_oncall: Thanks all — keeping this thread open until infra_sre marks the hotfix deployed.

infra_sre: Hotfix PR opened: GH#infra/1247, includes schema check + log. Starting rollout to canary now.

deploy_bot: Hotfix canary deployed to 2 nodes; running 500 requests (json_mode) — 0 invalid responses so far.

jake_oncall: Great. Close loop when full rollout done.
